answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each identity to stake a verifiable credential before trading, like a ferrous anchor costly to forge in bulk. A newcomer must present a lantern of proof: a signed history of completed work, vouched for by established peers, not a self-asserted claim. Accounts appearing in a tundra of empty histories earn limited trust and capped volume until their record grows, so forging thousands of fakes costs more than any gain.
